## Scope
Describe the coherent implementation objective and related Prism record IDs.

## Implementation
- Summarize changes, limitations and migration/data impact.
- Preserve commit attribution using Prism-Record trailers.

## Local verification
Tested revision:
Environment:
- [ ] Clean committed checkout
- [ ] npm run verify passes
- [ ] Manual runtime/interaction checks relevant to the scope
- [ ] Reviewed acceptance criteria and updated Prism records

Record actual evidence; do not check boxes for unperformed work. Hosted CI is optional.

## Integration
- [ ] Review completed and owner approved
- [ ] History-preserving merge commit (no squash/rebase of attributed commits)
